manifesto.heroScene: A soft, organic total lunar eclipse filling the upper portion of the frame: the Moon dim and muted, glowing gently in soft copper and rose tones — not bright or sun-like, more like a hazy, veiled orb partially in shadow. The entire background is a deep violet-purple night sky (like #450e5d), NOT black — the purple tone fills the whole frame, soft cosmic haze, delicate faint stars, painterly and dreamy, low contrast, atmospheric, wide open negative space around the moon, no text.
